Choose what to join

Keep paragraphs joins single line breaks with spaces and keeps a blank line between paragraphs. One line joins all line breaks. Spaces and tabs at a joined line’s edge are trimmed; spacing inside a line is preserved.

Windows CRLF, Unix LF and old-style CR line endings are supported. Unicode line and paragraph separators are recognized too. Hyphenated words stay hyphenated: the tool cannot know whether a hyphen belongs in a word.

Do not use automatic joining for code, poetry, addresses or tables without reviewing every affected line.

Private processing, reversible actions

Your input, preview and single-step undo state stay in this tab’s memory. They are not saved or uploaded. Choose Clear to empty both fields; Undo remains available until another action replaces it or you leave the page.

The tool does not read the clipboard. Copy result writes only when you press it. If copying is blocked, the result is selected for your device’s manual Copy command.

Text cleanup, not document reconstruction

Joining lines does not rebuild a PDF’s columns, detect headings, fix OCR mistakes or remove rich formatting from a file. Paste text into the field, choose the simplest transformation that fits, and compare the preview with your source.

For source fonts and colors, use the plain-text tool. For a repeated Windows workflow, keep reusable text in Clipora snippets.
